hints.title: Difference Representation
hints.text: Transform each string into its sequence of adjacent character difference values.

hints.title: Group Equivalence
hints.text: Every word except one shares the exact same sequence of difference values. Store them by tuple signature.

hints.title: Identify Singleton
hints.text: Find the unique difference tuple that belongs to only a single word and return that word.

hints.title: Difference Array Extraction Implementation

complexity.notes: Computing differences takes linear time with respect to the input characters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise string comparison repeated across all words causes quadratic comparisons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n * m) space to index difference signatures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Extracts invariant difference tuples and groups words to isolate the outlier.
